parameters.name: soiling_time_constant
parameters.justification: Soiling of white roof surfaces saturates within ~1 year (CRRC: most of the 3-year loss occurs in year 1). s = t/renewal_period is the normalized age of the exposed sheet; a is the soiling-induced solar absorptance increase; the equation is the time derivative of da/dt = (soiling_saturation_loss - a)/soiling_time_constant, and the Robin condition at s=1 restates that first-order law.

parameters.name: soiling_saturation_loss
parameters.justification: Saturated reflectance loss of a porous white mineral surface in a dusty hot city, a little worse than acrylic (0.18).

parameters.name: solar_irradiance_daily_mean
parameters.justification: Horizontal roof, clear hot summer day.

parameters.name: renewal_period
parameters.justification: Design: ~2 years per shed sheet; upper bound widened to 10 years, the repaint interval of the conventional baseline.
